test_title: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 12 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which Amendment extended the reservation of seats for SCs and STs in the legislatures for another 10 years till 2030?
solution:
The correct answer is __**104th Amendment**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **104th Constitutional Amendment Act** of India was passed in the year **2020**.
 
• This amendment extended the provision of **reservation for Scheduled Castes (SCs) and Scheduled Tribes (STs)** in the Lok Sabha and State Legislative Assemblies for another **10 years**, until **2030**.
 
• Initially, the reservation for SCs and STs in legislatures was provided for a period of **10 years** after the commencement of the Indian Constitution in **1950**.
 
• The reservation has been extended every 10 years through various Constitutional Amendment Acts to ensure the representation of SCs and STs in legislatures.
 
• The **104th Amendment Act** also abolished the provision for the nomination of two members from the Anglo-Indian community to the Lok Sabha and State Legislative Assemblies.
 
• This amendment highlights India's commitment to empowering marginalized communities and ensuring their representation in the democratic process.
 
• The reservation policy seeks to address **historical social inequalities** and provide political opportunities to SCs and STs.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **105th Amendment**__

 __
 
• The **105th Constitutional Amendment Act** was passed in **2021**.
 
• It restored the power of the states to identify and notify **Socially and Educationally Backward Classes (SEBCs)**.
 
• This amendment clarified the role of states in defining SEBCs after the **Supreme Court’s judgment in the Maratha reservation case**.
 
 
 
• **101st Amendment**__
 __
 
• The **101st Constitutional Amendment Act** introduced the **Goods and Services Tax (GST)** in India.
 
• It was passed in **2016** and unified indirect taxes under a single framework.
 
• This amendment established the **GST Council** to make recommendations on the implementation of GST.
 
 
 
• **103rd Amendment**__
 
 
• The **103rd Constitutional Amendment Act** was passed in **2019**.
 
• It introduced a provision for **10% reservation for Economically Weaker Sections (EWS)** in educational institutions and government jobs.
 
• This amendment added **Articles 15(6) and 16(6)** to the Indian Constitution.
